reason: The worklist title differs from the current arXiv v1 title for the same listed arXiv ID; the primary manuscript studies prompt confidentiality across local serving boundaries, including residual allocator memory and sanitization. Its core contribution is a security/privacy audit, not inference computation or serving efficiency. Sanitization reduces recovered prompt residue at less than about 0.5% latency difference, but does not restore confidentiality; that overhead measurement does not change the paper's unrelated scope disposition.
title: Running an LLM Locally Doesn't Keep Prompts Private: They Survive in Allocator Memory After Inference
